module_summary: Wishbone-to-AXI4 bridge: skid-buffered Wishbone requests issue single-beat AXI reads or writes in one direction at a time, tracked by a pending counter, with a subword address FIFO selecting returned read data.

anchors.name: i_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone request strobe entering the input skid buffer

anchors.name: m_ready
anchors.why: Accepts buffered request unless flushing, nearfull, direction change or AXI stalled

anchors.name: npending
anchors.why: Outstanding AXI transactions; derives empty, nearfull and full

anchors.name: o_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone acknowledge from successful AXI B or R response

anchors.name: m_valid
anchors.why: Buffered Wishbone request valid launching AXI address/data

anchors.name: m_we
anchors.why: Buffered write-enable choosing AXI write versus read transaction

anchors.name: direction
anchors.why: Current transfer direction; blocks opposite-direction requests until drained

anchors.name: flushing
anchors.why: Set on bus error or cycle abort; suppresses acks and new requests until empty

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: No pending transactions; allows direction change and ends flush

anchors.name: nearfull
anchors.why: Pending count near limit; stalls new requests

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pending counter full indication

anchors.name: o_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall from skid buffer not ready

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data selected from wide AXI read word

anchors.name: o_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone error from AXI error response

anchors.name: o_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid set on accepted Wishbone write

anchors.name: o_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid set with awvalid on accepted write

anchors.name: o_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Wishbone write data replicated across the wide AXI word

anchors.name: o_axi_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes shifted to the addressed subword lane

anchors.name: o_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address from Wishbone address

anchors.name: o_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid set on accepted Wishbone read

anchors.name: o_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address from Wishbone address

anchors.name: i_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read response; decrements pending and produces Wishbone ack

anchors.name: i_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response; decrements pending and produces Wishbone ack

anchors.name: i_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Wide AXI read data shifted down to Wishbone width

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.addr_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO of subword address bits for selecting returned read data lane

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.wr_addr
anchors.why: Subword FIFO write pointer advanced per accepted request

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.rd_addr
anchors.why: Subword FIFO read pointer advanced per AXI response

anchors.name: READ_FIFO_DATA_SELECT.return_data
anchors.why: AXI read word shifted by stored subword index to Wishbone data

groups.name: Wishbone input buffer
groups.description: Skid buffer capturing Wishbone requests with stall and accept gating

groups.name: Transaction controller
groups.description: Pending counter, direction lock and flush state controlling request acceptance

groups.name: AXI request issue
groups.description: Generates single-beat AXI write and read address/data channels

groups.name: Response return
groups.description: Converts AXI B/R responses to Wishbone ack/err and lane-selected read data
